about: Actos (pioglitazone), by brand name only, is supplied nine times from January to August 2026 to a 69-year-old man.
Pioglitazone (Actos) 15 mg is supplied four times from December 2025 to March 2026 to a 72-year-old woman, in the middle of a 14-month history.
There is no pioglitazone: the diabetes tablets are metformin and gliclazide, and Actonel Once-a-Week is risedronate, a bone medicine whose name looks like Actos.
